jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to sit on an Advisory Committee — it seeks established specialists (typically activists/practitioners from the named regions), not an entry-level paid role, and appears to be an unpaid advisory / speculative call with no salaried vacancy. Although human-rights and security work is a core interest, the role is a level and type mismatch for an early-career candidate.

jobs.title: Future Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: The role requires fluency in Dutch (min B2), which the candidate does not have (Dutch is A1) — a hard language disqualifier. It also seeks quality-assurance / HSE production experience entirely outside the candidate's profile and interests.

jobs.title: Subcontractor Auditor Integrated Systems
jobs.reason: Requires a technical engineering degree, at least 5 years of technical-industry experience, and business fluency in Polish — all essentials the candidate does not meet (no engineering degree, no Polish, no post-qualification experience). The role is a technical QSE auditor position entirely outside the candidate's field and level.

jobs.title: Freelance QHSE Auditor - Belgium
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: it requires a technical engineering degree, at least 5 years of technical-industry experience, and business fluency in Dutch and French — none of which the candidate has. The role is entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers apply: it is a "Lead Auditor" role requiring a minimum of four years' automotive-industry experience, essential fluency in Dutch, and specialist chemistry/quality-engineering knowledge (IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, FMEA) the candidate does not have. The field is entirely outside the candidate's interests and profile.

jobs.title: SOC Operations Technical Lead
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: it is a senior "Technical Lead" role requiring 7+ years in security operations with 3–4 years in a lead capacity, and it demands deep hands-on SOC/SIEM/EDR technical expertise the candidate lacks entirely. This is a security-operations leadership position far outside the candidate's profile and interests.

jobs.title: Future Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Requires fluency in Dutch (min B2) as an essential, which the candidate does not have (Dutch is A1). It is also a quality-assurance/HSE auditor role well outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with relevant field experience, which the candidate (student-assistant / RA background) does not have, and it functions as an advisory/voluntary appointment rather than a genuine paid vacancy. Although the human-rights and securitisation subject matter is of core interest, the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.
